datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Mali to classify geographic areas into IPC acute food insecurity phases. The resulting spatial classifications represent population-level food security outcomes aggregated by administrative or survey-defined units, with underlying drivers including drought and conflict-related disruptions to livelihoods and food systems.

sources.description: Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) spatial data collected through regular enumerator surveys. IPC classifications represent acute food insecurity outcomes driven by underlying hazards including drought.
